risk_if_not_implemented: Without Criticality Analysis During Development, the organization's most critical assets may not receive proportionate protection, leaving them disproportionately exposed to compromise. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Testing Throughout Development
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to require system developers/integrators consult with security, compliance and/or resilience personnel to: 
(1) Create and implement a Security Testing and Evaluation (ST&E) plan, or similar capability;
(2) Implement a verifiable flaw remediation process to correct weaknesses and deficiencies identified during the control testing and evaluation process; and
(3) Document the results.
compensating_control_1.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Testing Throughout Development (TDA-17) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Criticality Analysis During Development (TDA-05.1) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Secure Engineering Principles
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of industry-recognized security, compliance and resilience practices in the specification, design, development, implementation and modification of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_2.justification: Secure Engineering Principles (SEA-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Criticality Analysis During Development (TDA-05.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
